provenance.buildNote: Built from source to a single-threaded pyodide emscripten wheel (Cython + C++ EMD network-simplex; OpenMP auto-disabled by POT's check_openmp_support under emcc). Toolchain: pyodide-build 0.35.1 xbuildenv 0.28.0 + emscripten 4.0.9, Python 3.13.2 — produces platform tag pyemscripten_2025_0_wasm32, matching the repo's numpy/scipy/casadi cohort. Reproducible build in build/pot/. Wheel validated in a real pyodide 0.28.0 venv against numpy 2.2.5 + scipy 1.14.1: golden ot.emd2([0.5,0.5],[0.0,1.0],[[0,1],[1,0]]) == 0.5.
